name: Cintas
outlook:
What Cintas says to expect

  • Fiscal 2027: revenue and adjusted EPSAs we look forward to what lies ahead for fiscal 2027, we are raising our full fiscal year financial guidance. We are raising our annual revenue expectations from a range of $12.10 billion to $12.25 billion to a range of $12.15 billion to $12.27 billion, and we are raising our adjusted diluted EPS expectations from a range of $5.36 to $5.50 to a range of $5.45 to $5.54.
  • Fiscal 2027: effective tax rateFiscal year 2027 effective tax rate is expected to be 20.4% compared to 20.2% in fiscal year 2026.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed September 23, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
